title: Dangerous goods licence
summary: Find information and apply for various types of dangerous goods licences required for transporting dangerous materials in NSW.

internal_links.text: Apply for a dangerous goods driver licence
Apply for a dangerous goods vehicle licence
Apply for a licence to transport explosives or security sensitive dangerous substances

faqs.q: How do I apply for a dangerous goods licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for different types of dangerous goods licences, including for drivers, vehicles, and specific substances, depending on your needs.

faqs.q: What if I need to check my existing dangerous goods licence?
faqs.a: You can check the status of your dangerous goods licence using the dedicated service.
